title.en: Epoch AI and METR publish MirrorCode results for long-horizon coding tasks
title.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 METR 发布 MirrorCode 长程编程任务结果

searchSummary.en: Epoch AI and METR published MirrorCode results on long-horizon coding tasks that require models to reimplement programs without source-code or web access. One Claude Opus 4.7 run completed a 16,000-line target in 14 hours at a reported $251 inference cost.
searchSummary.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 METR 发布了 MirrorCode 长程编程任务结果。该基准要求模型在没有源代码和网络访问的条件下重建程序。一轮 Claude Opus 4.7 运行以报告的 251 美元推理成本，在 14 小时内完成了一个约 1.6 万行的目标程序。

summary.en: Epoch AI and METR published MirrorCode results on long-horizon coding tasks that require models to reimplement programs without source-code or web access. One Claude Opus 4.7 run completed a 16,000-line target in 14 hours at a reported $251 inference cost.
summary.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 METR 发布了 MirrorCode 长程编程任务结果。该基准要求模型在没有源代码和网络访问的条件下重建程序。一轮 Claude Opus 4.7 运行以报告的 251 美元推理成本，在 14 小时内完成了一个约 1.6 万行的目标程序。

narrative.en: MirrorCode uses end-to-end tests over 25 target programs. The results show that models can complete some substantial reimplementation tasks under the benchmark’s conditions. Epoch also reports a 56% headline score for Opus 4.7 and warns that target programs may have appeared in training data.
narrative.zhHans: MirrorCode 对 25 个目标程序进行端到端测试。结果显示，模型能在该基准条件下完成部分规模较大的重建任务。Epoch 同时报告 Opus 4.7 的总体得分为 56%，并提醒目标程序可能出现在训练数据中。

description.en: MirrorCode provides evidence that current models can complete some long-horizon program-reimplementation tasks under controlled conditions.
description.zhHans: MirrorCode 提供证据表明，现有模型能在受控条件下完成部分长程程序重建任务。

text.en: MirrorCode evaluates end-to-end program reimplementation without source-code or web access across 25 target programs.
text.zhHans: MirrorCode 在 25 个目标程序上评估端到端程序重建，模型无法访问源代码或网络。

text.en: Epoch reported that one Claude Opus 4.7 run reimplemented a 16,000-line target in 14 hours at a $251 inference cost.
text.zhHans: Epoch 报告称，一轮 Claude Opus 4.7 运行以 251 美元推理成本，在 14 小时内重建了一个约 1.6 万行的目标程序。

text.en: Epoch reports that pretraining exposure to open-source targets may inflate benchmark performance.
text.zhHans: Epoch 报告称，模型可能在预训练中接触过开源目标程序，这可能抬高基准表现。
